desc: Analyze problem: any alkane can be rooted at a degree-4 vertex, giving exactly 4 independent branches; define directed message msg[u->v] = max size of valid branch rooted at u attached to v.
Implement iterative rooting (parent array + BFS order) and bottom-up pass computing down[u] = msg[u->parent[u]] = max(1, 1 + top3 of children downs).
Implement top-down rerooting pass: up[v] = msg[parent->v] using top-3 incoming messages to parent excluding v (top-4 truncation trick).
For every vertex with >= 4 incoming messages, candidate = 1 + sum of top four messages; output global max, else -1.
Verify O(N log N) time, no recursion-depth issues, and handle edge cases (N < 5, no vertex of degree >= 4).
